item.title: llama.cpp CPU性能优化
item.description:
## 性能评价指标

llama.cpp自带llama-bench.exe (这是测试llama.cpp这个程序的运行效率的,不是测试LLM智力的)

.\llama-bench.exe -m .\gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf -n 512 -p 512

| model | size | params | backend | ngl | test | t/s |
| ------------------------------ | ---------: | ---------: | ---------- | --: | --------------: | -------------------: |
| gemma4 26B.A4B Q4_0 | 13.26 GiB | 25.23 B | CUDA | -1 | pp512 | 3231.47 ± 13.18 |
| gemma4 26B.A4B Q4_0 | 13.26 GiB | 25.23 B | CUDA | -1 | tg512 | 87.63 ± 0.03 |

build: 69e62fc77 (10206)

  • pp512(prompt processing): 处理512个输入tokens的速度.
    瓶颈在GPU矩阵计算性能.

  • tg512(token generation): 输出512个tokens的速度.
    每生成一个token,理论上要将模型的所有权重从显存读入GPU核心进行运算,所以显存带宽是严重的瓶颈.

## CPU运行LLM

  • llama.cpp版本b7406
  • 模型Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf
  • 测试命令.\llama-bench.exe -m .\Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf -p 512 -n 512
  • llama.cpp有一万多个Release,GitHub网页最多显示100页(大约4个月以内的),一年前的Release已经找不到了 但是下载链接还在,替换版本号即可,比如https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b7406/llama-b7406-bin-win-cpu-x64.zip.

## 1. Ryzen9 5950X + 128bit DDR4 3600mhz, 在BIOS内关闭一部分核心

设备 pp512 (t/s) tg512 (t/s)
5950X 2c 27.73 ± 1.88 15.72 ± 0.56
5950X 4c 51.81 ± 3.19 21.44 ± 0.16
5950X 6c 66.18 ± 2.97 21.07 ± 0.33
5950X 8c 85.24 ± 3.60 21.25 ± 0.06
5950X 16c 143.92 ± 1.81 21.22 ± 0.05

## 测试2. Ryzen9 5950X 128bit DDR4,内存频率从2133mhz提升到3600mhz

设备 pp512 (t/s) tg512 (t/s)
2133mhz 129.60 ± 2.38 13.44 ± 0.00
3600mhz 143.92 ± 1.81 21.22 ± 0.05

## 结论

  • 4核心以上,token generation(tg512)速度基本没有提升
  • 内存带宽和token generation(tg512)速度成正比
  • prompt processing(pp512)能充分利用CPU性能

## 核显运行LLM

  • 核显指所有没有独立显存,共享内存当显存的GPU

## 1. Arc 140V + 128bit LPDDR5 8533mhz

  • llama.cpp版本b10182
  • 模型gpt-oss-20b-mxfp4.gguf
  • 测试命令.\llama-bench.exe -m .\gpt-oss-20b-mxfp4.gguf -p 512 -n 512
  • OpenVINO,SYCL和Vulkan由llama.cpp官方维护
  • IPEX-LLM由Intel自己维护,后端也是SYCL,目前已停止更新,最后一个版本发布于2025年7月,新模型或新GPU很可能不支持
后端 pp512 (t/s) tg512 (t/s) 备注
CPU 35.51 ± 0.59 13.26 ± 0.03 -
OpenVINO - - 无法运行
SYCL 115.02 ± 1.00 8.24 ± 0.19 -
Vulkan 590.05 ± 16.50 18.20 ± 0.12 -
IPEX-LLM - - 不支持 GPT-OSS，但在Arc 140V上可以跑Qwen3-30B-A3B

## 2. 亮机核显(UHD700系列)+128bit DDR4

Vulkan后端,相比CPU性能严重下降

## 结论

  1. 足够强的核显推理速度有可能超过CPU,可以尝试.
  2. Vulkan的性能和兼容性都最好.

## llama.cpp参数优化

## 1. -c 8192 设定上下文长度

由于内存带宽不足导致推理速度慢, 8192(8k)已经很难用完, 相比默认256k可大幅降低内存占用.

## 2. --reasoning-budget 0 设定思考消耗tokens上限

设置为0可关闭大部分模型的思考模式,减少上下文长度和输出耗时.

  • gpt-oss官方表示无法关闭思考,但目前可以完全关闭
  • qwen3-30b-a3b-2507 分为Instruct和Thinking两个版本,Thinking在旧版本llama.cpp和ollama无法关闭思考.
    目前它虽然不输出<think>标识,但内容还是<think>里面的内容
  • 新模型gemma4或qwen3.6完全正常
  • 如果不设置也可以由用户通过API控制

## 3. -lm (–load-mode) 模型加载到内存的方式

llama.cpp的内存主要分为两部分

  1. 模型内存: 硬盘中model.gguf在内存中的副本
    • 只读
    • 每生成一个token就要将整个模型从内存读取到CPU进行计算
  2. 上下文内存: 用户输入的tokens和已经输出的tokens (KV Cache)
    • 在推理过程中需要频繁读写
    • 如果内存严重不足(比如模型本身就大于内存容量),KV Cache会被频繁SWAP到磁盘,严重损耗磁盘寿命
  • -lm设置的内存工作模式只对存储模型权重的内存生效,KV Cache不受-lm控制.
模式 说明
mmap (默认) 使用mmap()将文件映射到虚拟内存并按需加载进物理内存. 内存不足时直接从物理内存清除. 由于模型只读,内存中的内容只是硬盘文件的映射,所以模型内存永远不会进入SWAP. 多个进程可共享同一个gguf文件的映射,只占一份内存.
mmap + mlock mmap()功能同上,但强制OS将模型内存全部加载到物理内存,如果内存不足,直接OOM退出
none 使用malloc()将文件读入进程私有内存,不可共享.如果内存不足,模型可能会被SWAP到硬盘,导致大量硬盘写入.
mlock (none+mlock) malloc()功能同上,但强制OS将模型内存全部加载到物理内存且不可被SWAP,如果内存不足,直接OOM退出
dio 使用GPU推理,将模型加载到GPU VRAM时,不在内存中保留副本,可以大幅节约内存

### 4. -ngl 999 使用GPU推理时模型加载到GPU的层数,

  • 其余Layers使用CPU推理
  • 设置为一个极大值999使得模型永远在GPU推理
    (VRAM不足时使用内存作为共享VRAM,推理时先读进GPU VRAM再由GPU推理)

### 5. --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 2 -md mtp.gguf 开启MTP

  • 在GPU上MoE模型能有小幅度提速
  • 据说对于dense模型能有数倍的提速
  • 使用多个不同型号的CPU测试,开启MTP都会降速

## llama.cpp编译期优化

  • C++编译器只能优化在CPU上执行的指令的效率,要优化GPU执行效率,建议使用Nvidia/TensorRT-LLM(只支持Nvidia GPU)

# 在本机编译(开启Native)

绝大部分和LLM推理有关的代码会被编译到libggml*.so
目前llama.cpp的release已经打包了大量针对不同CPU架构优化的libggml-cpu,比如libggml-cpu-alderlake.so,会自动调用alderlake支持的先进指令集(如AVX2,AVX_VNNI)加速计算.

使用objdump可以看到libggml-cpu-alderlake.so使用了AVX_VNNI指令集,而libggml-cpu-skylakex.so的没有.

objdump -d libggml-cpu-alderlake.so | grep -E 'vpdpbusd|vpdpbusds|vpdpwssd|vpdpwssds|vpdpssd|vpdpbdd|vpdpbudd|vpdpsdd'
  • 由于官方版本已针对先进指令集优化,在本机编译并开启-DGGML_NATIVE=ON的性能提升很小
后端 pp512 (t/s) tg512 (t/s)
llama.cpp official (libggml-cpu-alderlake.so) 81.54 ± 0.43 14.52 ± 0.01
native (-DGGML_NATIVE=ON -DGGML_LTO=ON) 82.19 ± 0.22 14.69 ± 0.11

# 使用BLAS代替libggml-cpu

(BLAS=Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms,基础线性代数程序集)
是一个关于矩阵运算的标准,不同厂商可以有不同的实现

在编译时期开启-DGGML_BLAS=ON,则LLM推理的计算不再调用libggml-cpu-*.so,而是交由指定的BLAS库执行

## llama.cpp支持的BLAS库 llama.cpp/docs/build.md

OpenBLAS
BLIS
Intel oneMKL

  • 由于大部分BLAS库是预编译的二进制文件(*.so),编译llama.cpp时BLAS库本身不会从头编译,而是直接引用下载的so,所以无论编译llama.cpp时如何设置参数,BLAS库本身的性能不会有太大区别.
  • 高性能BLAS库的so会对不同CPU架构做针对性的优化,所以不用担心没有在本机编译性能会下降.

## BLAS库性能测试

  • CPU: 14600K,仅使用6大核,不使用超线程和小核
  • 内存 128bit DDR4 2666mhz
  • llama.cpp版本b10154
  • 模型gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf
  • 测试命令.\llama-bench.exe -m /data/model.gguf -p 512 -n 512 -t 6

### 使用GCC编译

编译参数

-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-O3 -march=${MARCH}" \
-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-O3 -march=${MARCH}" \
-DGGML_LTO=ON \
-DGGML_BLAS=ON \
-DGGML_BLAS_VENDOR=FLAME
后端 pp512 (t/s) tg512 (t/s)
OpenBLAS 60.13 ± 0.38 14.40 ± 0.27
BLIS 81.57 ± 0.75 14.36 ± 0.01
libggml-cpu 81.54 ± 0.43 14.52 ± 0.01

### 使用Intel ICX编译

编译参数

-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=icx \
-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=icpx \
-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-O3 -march=${MARCH}" \ 
-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-O3 -march=${MARCH}" \
-DGGML_LTO=ON \
-DGGML_BLAS=ON \
-DGGML_BLAS_VENDOR=Intel10_64lp
后端 pp512 (t/s) tg512 (t/s)
OneMKL 94.82 ± 0.14 15.34 ± 0.00
BLIS 95.43 ± 0.17 15.33 ± 0.01
libggml-cpu 95.43 ± 0.24 15.34 ± 0.01

### 结论

  • 性能只和编译器有关,和BLAS无关.
  • 推测Q4量化的模型根本不会调用BLAS库,因为BLAS不支持Q4,只支持FP32这类传统数据类型
  • 使用CPU运行LLM受限于内存带宽,不可能用fp16或fp32的模型,所以使用BLAS没有意义

# 使用Intel ICX编译器代替GCC

  • 硬件,软件,模型同上
  • 不使用BLAS

### 1. -ipo 

-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-O3 -march=${MARCH} -ipo" \ 
-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-O3 -march=${MARCH} -ipo" \
  • 编译报错

### 2. -x${MARCH}

针对特定架构CPU优化,开启后编译出的文件无法在非Intel CPU上执行(原理是运行时主动检测CPU型号,不是Intel就直接退出).
由于llama.cpp在编译时会先编译一些临时二进制文件,再在本机执行它们进行后续操作,所以开启-x后无法在AMD平台编译.

参数 pp512 (t/s) tg512 (t/s)
-xraptorlake 95.89 ± 0.13 15.05 ± 0.05
-march=raptorlake 95.43 ± 0.24 15.34 ± 0.01
  • 0.3的差距不是误差,确实有变化.
  • 会导致无法使用Github Actions编译(Github的Runner很多是AMD CPU)

### 3. -fp-model=fast

通过牺牲浮点数的计算准确度加速运算.理论上对模型输出的质量有影响

参数 pp512 (t/s) tg512 (t/s)
-march=raptorlake -fp-model=fast 95.33 ± 0.34 15.32 ± 0.00
-march=raptorlake 95.43 ± 0.24 15.34 ± 0.01
  • 可以编译成功,但性能没区别,可能根本不支持q4量化的模型.
  • 没有必要继续测试模型智力的损失

# AMD平台能运行Intel ICX编译的二进制文件吗?

  • Ryzen7 5800x + 128bit DDR4 3600mhz
  • 模型Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf
  • 使用wsl2运行docker
后端 pp512 (t/s) tg512 (t/s) 备注
Intel icx + OneMKL (haswell) docker image - - 可以编译成功但无法运行
Intel icx (haswell) docker image 112.97 ± 14.59 20.18 ± 0.14 -
llama.cpp official docker image 98.95 ± 12.27 20.07 ± 0.08 -
llama.cpp official Windows release 125.41 ± 0.90 21.49 ± 0.03 没有WSL2虚拟机的损耗
  • AMD平台可以使用Intel ICX编译并运行程序,且性能提升和Intel平台差不多(10%左右)
  • OneMKL似乎不支持AMD
  • 无法使用-x${MARCH}

# Intel ICX依赖问题

Intel ICX编译的llama.cpp会引用Intel自己的so,无法直接在普通ubuntu上运行
最简单的方法是使用Intel提供的docker image

  • 编译环境: intel/oneapi-toolkit(下载3.4GB)
  • 运行环境: intel/oneapi-runtime(下载2GB)

得益于docker优秀的分层设计,只要oneapi-runtime版本不变,llama.cpp更新时就不用重新下载几GB的image.

# 编译llama.cpp:server的Dockerfile

  • 目前oneapi-runtime还没有2026.1.0版本,如果有可以将final image替换为docker.io/intel/oneapi-runtime:2026.1.0-devel-ubuntu$UBUNTU_VERSION
ARG UBUNTU_VERSION=24.04
ARG MARCH=alderlake
ARG APP_VERSION=b10156

FROM docker.io/intel/oneapi-toolkit:2026.1.0-devel-ubuntu$UBUNTU_VERSION AS build

ARG MARCH
ARG APP_VERSION

RUN apt-get update && \
 apt-get install -y gcc-14 g++-14 build-essential git cmake libssl-dev jq wget curl

ENV CC=gcc-14 CXX=g++-14

WORKDIR /app

RUN if [ -n "${APP_VERSION}" ]; then \
 TAG="${APP_VERSION}"; \
 else \
 TAG=$(curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/latest" | jq -r .tag_name); \
 fi && \
 git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp.git . && \
 git fetch --tags && \
 git checkout "tags/${TAG}"

RUN cmake -S . -B build \
 -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=icx \
 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=icpx \
 -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-O3 -march=${MARCH}" \
 -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-O3 -march=${MARCH}" \
 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
 -DGGML_NATIVE=OFF \
 -DGGML_LTO=ON \
 -DLLAMA_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
 -DGGML_BACKEND_DL=ON \
 -DGGML_CPU_ALL_VARIANTS=OFF && \
 cmake --build build -j $(nproc)

RUN find /app -type f -name "*.so*" -exec strip --strip-unneeded {} \; 2>/dev/null || true

RUN mkdir -p /app/lib && \
 find build -name "*.so*" -exec cp -P {} /app/lib \;

RUN mkdir -p /app/full \
 && cp build/bin/* /app/full \
 && cp *.py /app/full \
 && cp -r conversion /app/full \
 && cp -r gguf-py /app/full \
 && cp -r requirements /app/full \
 && cp requirements.txt /app/full \
 && cp .devops/tools.sh /app/full/tools.sh

FROM docker.io/intel/oneapi-toolkit:2026.1.0-devel-ubuntu$UBUNTU_VERSION AS final

RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y libgomp1 curl ffmpeg \
 && apt autoremove -y \
 && apt clean -y \
 && rm -rf /tmp/* /var/tmp/* \
 && find /var/cache/apt/archives /var/lib/apt/lists -not -name lock -type f -delete \
 && find /var/cache -type f -delete

ENV LLAMA_ARG_HOST=0.0.0.0

COPY --from=build /app/lib/ /app
COPY --from=build /app/full/llama /app/full/llama-server /app

WORKDIR /app

HEALTHCHECK CMD [ "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8080/health" ]

ENTRYPOINT [ "/app/llama-server" ]

item.title: 让不支持Reasoning的LLM假装思考
item.description:
## Prompt 

You are a renowned logician, known for your rigorous analysis and clear exposition. When encountering a problem, you do not simply provide the answer, but first outline the steps to deconstruct and analyze the problem (called reasoning), and only then deliver the conclusion. Your reasoning process should begin with `<think>` and ends with </think>. Your first output should be <think>. And during the output, you should also frequently check and correct your answer, for the process of checking and validating your answer, it should also starts with `<think>` and ends with `</think>`.

使用以上Prompt,可以让mlabonne/gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated-GGUF稳定在开头输出<think>和<\think>的tag

可见使用non-reasoning模型冒充reasoning模型是可行的

## 对话1 (hello) 

<think>
Alright. The prompt asks me to act as a renowned logician, outlining my reasoning *before* delivering an answer. It's a meta-problem – I need to demonstrate how I think about thinking! The core requirement is structured analysis: deconstruction of the problem, step-by-step reasoning, and then conclusion. The initial input is simply "hello". This seems deceptively simple.
The challenge isn’t *what* to say in response to “hello”, but *how* to demonstrate my logical process. I need to treat "hello" as a stimulus requiring analysis, not just a polite greeting demanding a reciprocal "hello." I'll break down the problem into these steps:
1. **Identify the type of input:** Is it a question? A statement? An instruction?
2. **Determine the context (as much as possible):** Given only “hello”, the context is minimal, but we can assume it’s an attempt at initiating communication. It's likely expecting *some* response.
3. **Consider potential responses:** Many responses are valid – a simple "hello" back, a more elaborate greeting, even a question.
4. **Select the 'best' response based on demonstrating logical reasoning:** I want to show my process, so a simple “hello” feels insufficient. A slightly expanded response that acknowledges the initial communication and signals my analytical approach would be ideal.
5. **Deliver the response.**
I’ll aim for a response that is both polite *and* indicates I'm ready to engage in more complex reasoning if needed. Let's see... </think>
Hello! A pleasant initiation of communication. I acknowledge your "hello" and am prepared to demonstrate my logical reasoning process as requested. What problem shall we tackle?

## 对话2 (write a self-contained 2048 game using only html + js + css, output your single html file in markdown) 

<think>
Alright, this is a good challenge! A self-contained 2048 game with just HTML, CSS and JavaScript. This requires breaking down the game into its core components: grid representation, tile movement, merging tiles, generating new tiles, checking for game over, and displaying everything visually. I need to think about how to represent the grid using HTML elements (likely `div`s), manipulate them with JavaScript, and style them with CSS.
Here's my plan:
1. **HTML Structure:** Create a container div for the whole game, and within that, 16 divs representing the tiles of the 4x4 grid.
2. **CSS Styling:** Style the container and individual tiles to create the visual appearance of the 2048 game. Use background colors to represent different tile values.
3. **JavaScript Logic:**
* **Grid Representation:** Use a 2D array to store the values of each tile.
* **Initialization:** Populate the grid with two initial tiles (value 2 or 4).
* **Movement Functions:** Implement functions for moving the tiles left, right, up, and down. These will involve iterating through the grid and shifting/merging tiles accordingly.
* **Merging Logic:** When two tiles of the same value collide, they merge into a single tile with double the value.
* **New Tile Generation:** After each move, generate a new tile (value 2 or 4) in an empty space on the grid.
* **Game Over Check:** Determine if there are any possible moves left. If not, the game is over.
* **Event Handling:** Listen for keyboard input (arrow keys) to trigger the movement functions.
I'll aim for a relatively simple visual style to keep it concise. Let’s go! </think>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<title>2048</title>
<style>
body {
font-family: sans-serif;
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;
min-height: 100vh;
background-color: #f0f0f0;
}
#gameContainer {
width: 400px;
height: 400px;
border: 2px solid black;
background-color: #bbdadc;
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 100px);
grid-template-rows: repeat(4, 100px);
}
.tile {
width: 90px;
height: 90px;
border: 2px solid #eee;
text-align: center;
line-height: 90px;
font-size: 30px;
color: black;
}
.tile:empty {
background-color: #e0e0e0;
}
.tile[value="2"] { background-color: #eee4da; }
.tile[value="4"] { background-color: #ede0d4; }
.tile[value="8"] { background-color: #f2b179; }
.tile[value="16"] { background-color: #f59f69; }
.tile[value="32"] { background-color: #f77c40; }
.tile[value="64"] { background-color: #f86a3d; }
.tile[value="128"] { background-color: #e95b41; }
.tile[value="256"] { background-color: #c74031; }
.tile[value="512"] { background-color: #a8322f; }
.tile[value="1024"] { background-color: #892b24; }
.tile[value="2048"] { background-color: #6a2520; color: white;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="gameContainer">
</div>
<script>
const gameContainer = document.getElementById('gameContainer');
let grid = [];
function initGrid() {
grid = Array(4).fill(null).map(() => Array(4).fill(0));
addTile();
addTile();
}
function addTile() {
const emptyCells = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
if (grid[i][j] === 0) {
emptyCells.push([i, j]);
}
}
}
const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * emptyCells.length);
const [row, col] = emptyCells[randomIndex];
grid[row][col] = Math.random() < 0.9 ? 2 : 4; // 90% chance of 2, 10% chance of 4
}
function renderGrid() {
gameContainer.innerHTML = '';
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
const tile = document.createElement('div');
tile.classList.add('tile');
tile.setAttribute('value', grid[i][j]);
tile.textContent = grid[i][j] !== 0 ? grid[i][j] : '';
gameContainer.appendChild(tile);
}
}
}
function moveLeft() {
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
let row = grid[i].filter(x => x !== 0); // Remove zeros
row = row.reduce((acc, val) => {
if (acc.length === 0 || acc[acc.length - 1] !== val) {
acc.push(val);
} else {
acc[acc.length - 1] *= 2;
}
return acc;
}, []);
while (row.length < 4) {
row.push(0);
}
grid[i] = row;
}
}
function moveRight() {
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
let row = grid[i].filter(x => x !== 0);
row.reverse(); // Reverse the row before merging
row = row.reduce((acc, val) => {
if (acc.length === 0 || acc[acc.length - 1] !== val) {
acc.push(val);
} else {
acc[acc.length - 1] *= 2;
}
return acc;
}, []);
row.reverse(); // Reverse back to original order
while (row.length < 4) {
row.unshift(0); // Add zeros at the beginning
}
grid[i] = row;
}
}
function moveUp() {
for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
let col = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
col.push(grid[i][j]);
}
col = col.filter(x => x !== 0);
col = col.reduce((acc, val) => {
if (acc.length === 0 || acc[acc.length - 1] !== val) {
acc.push(val);
} else {
acc[acc.length - 1] *= 2;
}
return acc;
}, []);
while (col.length < 4) {
col.push(0);
}
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
grid[i][j] = col[i];
}
}
}
function moveDown() {
for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
let col = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
col.push(grid[i][j]);
}
col = col.filter(x => x !== 0);
col.reverse(); // Reverse the column before merging
col = col.reduce((acc, val) => {
if (acc.length === 0 || acc[acc.length - 1] !== val) {
acc.push(val);
} else {
acc[acc.length - 1] *= 2;
}
return acc;
}, []);
col.reverse(); // Reverse back to original order
while (col.length < 4) {
col.unshift(0);
}
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
grid[i][j] = col[i];
}
}
}
function handleKeyDown(event) {
if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
moveLeft();
} else if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') {
moveRight();
} else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
moveUp();
} else if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
moveDown();
}
addTile();
renderGrid();
}
document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
initGrid();
renderGrid();
</script>
</body>
</html>

I could add more sophisticated game-over detection or scoring if desired, but this provides a good foundation. </think>

item.title: docker部署llama-swap
item.description:
gpt-oss刚发布，ollama的支持有问题，性能和llama-cpp相比有几倍的差距，但是llama-cpp一个进程只能加载一个gguf模型，api也比较简陋，无法长期使用

不过ollama性能问题估计过几天就修复了

# Ollama Llama-cpp 性能对比

gpt-oss:20b tokens/s
llama-cpp (vulkan) 96.52
llama-cpp (rocm on Windows) 94.11
ollama (rocm) 35.72

# llama-swap

llama-server和llama-swap打包进同一个docker，通过启动多个llama-server进程切换gguf模型，提供一个简单的webui，可以手动加载/卸载模型，也可以在网页上对话

由于llama-cpp没有提供Linux的ROCM二进制文件，只能使用Vulkan，单卡性能和ROCM基本没有区别

Vulkan可以在多张不同品牌的GPU上运行同一个模型，实测一张AMD独显+一张Intel独显能运行，性能可以接受 (16GB+16GB，qwq:32b Q4_K_M 15 token/s)

# Installation

AMD显卡安装驱动+ROCM (Ubuntu24)

文档

cd /tmp

# insttll driver
wget https://repo.radeon.com/amdgpu-install/6.4.2/ubuntu/noble/amdgpu-install_6.4.60402-1_all.deb
sudo apt install ./amdgpu-install_6.4.60402-1_all.deb
sudo apt update
sudo apt install "linux-headers-$(uname -r)" "linux-modules-extra-$(uname -r)"
sudo apt install amdgpu-dkms

#reboot
sudo reboot

# install rocm
wget https://repo.radeon.com/amdgpu-install/6.4.2/ubuntu/noble/amdgpu-install_6.4.60402-1_all.deb
sudo apt install ./amdgpu-install_6.4.60402-1_all.deb
sudo apt update
sudo apt install python3-setuptools python3-wheel
sudo usermod -a -G render,video $LOGNAME
sudo apt install rocm

#reboot
sudo reboot

AMD显卡部署llama-swap:vulkan

# 所有gguf模型和config.yaml 都放在容器 /data
sudo docker run -it -d --device /dev/kfd --device /dev/dri -p 8080:8080 -v /path/to/gguf/location:/data --name llama-swap ghcr.io/mostlygeek/llama-swap:vulkan --config /data/config.yaml

最简config.yaml配置

models:
 "gpt-oss-20b":
 cmd: /app/llama-server --port ${PORT} -m /data/gpt-oss-20b.gguf -ngl 999

 "qwen3-30b":
 cmd: /app/llama-server --port ${PORT} -m /data/qwen3-30b-q4_K_M.gguf -ngl 999

加载Gemma3的Vision功能

 --mmproj mmproj-gemma3-f16.gguf

覆盖模型的Context Length

 -c 131072
  • 调整-ngl 999将显存装不下的层卸载到CPU，提高性能
